title: Torso S-4 project.json
description: The project.json inside a <NAME>.s4project folder, as saved by the Torso S-4 (OS 2.x, "version": "v14"). Learned from S-4 saves, calibration projects and hardware checks (VERIFY.md in s4tools). Most parameters are {value, mode} pairs in the S-4's own units; mode "" is the default mode, other modes by their lower-case name. x-label = the name on the S-4's screen, x-unit = the unit of value, x-cc = the MIDI CC that moves it (on the track's channel), default = what a fresh device stores. The folder also holds discs/scene<N>_track<T>.wav (DISC samples), tapes/scene<N>_track<T>_tape.wav and _poly.wav (TAPE / POLY), and granular_buffers/.
